title: Egyptian Biscuit Tagine Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish featuring chicken cooked in a rich tagine sauce with biscuits and served with a side of fluffy light rice.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then sear in a hot skillet with 1 tablespoon of olive oil until browned on both sides.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, then sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the crushed biscuit and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the Egyptian spice blend, tomato paste, and chicken broth.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the sauce to the baking dish with the chicken and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken with the tagine sauce spooned over the top, accompanied by a side of fluffy light rice.
